images.description: On the Way before: refused rows show only Failed with a chevron, undated rows show no length, no row actions

On the Way after: rows show time and length, short reasons (Invalid recording date, Too large, too old) and Retry/Delete actions over the whole recording; the too-large row offers Delete only, including the undated never-set-clock row
Device stats before: Heard today 0s and On Device 0s while a 33-minute episode runs and audio is queued on the phone
Device stats after: Heard today 33m counts the running episode, On Device names the 7h 45m phone queue, and the three tiles share one row height — the On Device captions raise the whole row
